_about: Facts stated on https://saikanagat.com, read 2026-11-16. Each claim carries the page it came from and one or more verbatim fragments of that page's rendered text (whitespace collapsed, curly quotes read as straight). No inference, no rounding, no converting dates. Date ranges keep the site's en dash. 'status' is 'stated' when no other page contradicts it, or 'conflicting' when another page says something different: a conflicting claim must not be used in a demo until Sai confirms which version is right (see GAPS.md, id in 'gap'). Brand-book specimen content (Northwind, Maria, the invoice, the phone number, the IBAN, the sample CV) is placeholder material and is deliberately not listed.
